tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence into lowercase word tokens using regex splitting with configurable keep and remove lists
load_str_list_from_file: load a text file and return a list of stripped lines as strings
create_vocabdict_from_word_list: create a VocabDict from a word list or file path with word to index and index to word mappings
build_vocab_from_text: build a VocabFromText vocabulary from a list of sentences with configurable minimum token count threshold
get_action_shortest_path: get the shortest path as a list of actions from a source position to a goal position in HabitatSim
